sections.intent: Walk visitors through the founding narrative in a personal, editorial voice that builds authenticity and emotional resonance.
sections.headline: A Kitchen Table, a Problem, and a Promise
sections.body: Lumi & Bloom was founded in 2019 by two friends who couldn't find a body care brand that checked every box: genuinely clean formulas, ingredients they could pronounce, sustainable packaging, and a price point that didn't feel like a luxury tax. So they made their own. Starting with a small batch of whipped shea butter in a shared apartment kitchen, they spent two years testing, refining, and listening to their community. Today, Lumi & Bloom ships to customers across the country — but the founding promise hasn't changed: every product should make you feel taken care of, inside and out.

sections.intent: Articulate the core brand values in a scannable, visually friendly format that resonates with the app-like layout aesthetic.
sections.headline: Our Values Aren't a Marketing Slide — They're Our Ingredient List
sections.subheadline: Every decision we make — from formula to packaging to partnerships — runs through these four commitments.

items.title: Radically Transparent
items.description: Full ingredient lists, sourcing notes, and formulation rationale published for every product. No fine print, no mystery.

items.title: Genuinely Clean
items.description: No parabens, sulfates, synthetic dyes, or fragrance shortcuts. Every ingredient earns its place in the formula.

items.title: Sustainably Packaged
items.description: Recycled and recyclable materials across our full range. We're on a path to 100% plastic-free by 2026.

items.title: Community First

sections.intent: Break down the sustainability strategy into four clear pillars that visitors can understand and evaluate on their own terms.
sections.headline: How We Think About Doing Better
sections.subheadline: Every sustainability decision at Lumi & Bloom runs through these four lenses.

items.title: Clean Formulation
items.description: We source only responsibly harvested, sustainably farmed botanical ingredients. No petrochemical derivatives. Full supply chain transparency.

items.title: Circular Packaging
items.description: We use post-consumer recycled plastics, glass, and aluminum. Our refill program lets customers return empties for a discount on their next order.

items.title: Climate Responsibility
items.description: All operations and shipping are carbon offset. We publish our annual carbon footprint report so you can hold us accountable.

items.title: Community Giving
items.description: 1% of every sale goes to environmental and women's wellness nonprofits selected by our customer community each year.

sections.intent: Show the sustainability roadmap — both what has been achieved and what is planned — to demonstrate forward momentum and honest accountability.
sections.headline: Where We've Been and Where We're Going
sections.subheadline: We share this publicly because accountability is part of the commitment.

items.title: 2021 — Recycled Packaging Introduced
items.description: Switched to post-consumer recycled materials for all bottles and jars, eliminating virgin plastic from 60% of the range.

items.title: 2022 — Carbon-Offset Shipping Launched
items.description: Partnered with a certified reforestation program to offset 100% of shipping emissions on every order.

items.title: 2023 — Refill Program Pilot
items.description: Launched a refill program for our top three products, reducing single-use packaging by an estimated 18,000 units annually.

items.title: 2024 — Full Refill Range Expansion
items.description: Expanding the refill program to cover the entire product catalog. Estimated completion: Q3 2024.

items.title: 2026 — 100% Plastic-Free Pledge
items.description: Full transition to glass, aluminum, and compostable materials across all products and shipping materials.

sections.intent: Preemptively answer the most common contact reasons to reduce friction for visitors who just need a quick answer.
sections.headline: The Questions We Get Most

items.title: How long does shipping take?
items.description: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days. Expedited options are available at checkout. All orders are carbon offset.

items.title: Are your products vegan and cruelty-free?
items.description: Yes, completely. Every Lumi & Bloom product is 100% vegan and we never test on animals. We are Leaping Bunny certified.

items.title: Can I return a product if I don't love it?
items.description: Absolutely. We offer a 30-day happiness guarantee. If a product isn't right for you, we'll make it right — no hassle.

items.title: Do you offer a refill program?
items.description: Yes! Our refill program is available for select products. Return your empty and get 15% off your next refill order.

items.title: Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?
items.description: Most of our range is formulated for all skin types, including sensitive. Each product page lists suitability clearly.
